name: Giant Hyena
description: A complete giant hyena with recognizable species anatomy and characteristic silhouette, natural colors, side or three-quarter view. Oversized powerful proportions; preserve the actual animal species, no extra limbs.

Broad flat color clusters, 12-20 colors, dark one-logical-pixel outline, light from upper left, strong readable silhouette. No gradients, blur, dithering, texture noise, text, watermark, UI panel, border, ground shadow or tiny decoration. Keep all identifying features readable after reduction to 32x32. Subject: A complete giant hyena with recognizable species anatomy and characteristic silhouette, natural colors, side or three-quarter view. Oversized powerful proportions; preserve the actual animal species, no extra limbs. Genuine transparent background. One complete centered subject with a one-pixel clear margin. Full body for creatures, full object for equipment. No scenery or extra objects beyond the stated subject.
